seoTitle: How to Add Skrill to Shopify as a Payment Method
metaDescription: Want to accept Skrill payments on Shopify? Here's how to enable and connect the Skrill gateway to your store and confirm checkout works correctly.
intro: Skrill is a widely used international payment gateway that supports multiple currencies, which makes it a useful option for Shopify sellers targeting global customers. This guide covers enabling Skrill in Shopify, connecting your account, and confirming the setup at checkout.

steps.heading: Open payment settings in Shopify Admin
steps.body: Navigate to your Shopify payment provider settings, where third-party gateways like Skrill can be added alongside or instead of Shopify Payments.

steps.heading: Enable the Skrill payment gateway
steps.body: Select Skrill from the list of available payment providers and choose to activate it for your store.

steps.heading: Connect your Skrill account
steps.body: Link your existing Skrill merchant account to Shopify by entering the required account credentials or API details in the gateway settings.

steps.heading: Verify account settings before activation
steps.body: Double-check your Skrill account information and currency settings so payments process correctly once the gateway goes live.

steps.heading: Test the checkout flow
steps.body: Run a test transaction to confirm Skrill appears as a payment option at checkout and that orders complete without errors.

faq.question: Do I need an existing Skrill account to use it on Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes, you connect your existing Skrill merchant account to Shopify rather than creating one from within Shopify itself.

faq.question: Can I use Skrill alongside Shopify Payments?
faq.answer: Yes, Skrill can be added as an additional payment method so customers have more ways to pay at checkout.

faq.question: Does Skrill support multiple currencies on Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes, Skrill is built for international transactions and supports multiple currencies, which is one of its main advantages for global sellers.

faq.question: Why isn't Skrill showing at checkout after setup?
faq.answer: This is often due to account verification not being complete or currency settings not matching, so it's worth reviewing your Skrill account status before testing again.
